message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,220p' build.sh && find freetype2 -maxdepth 3 -type f -path '*fuzz*' -o -path '*tests*' | grep -E 'fuzz|ftfuzzer' | head -200` executed with exit code 0.

function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,220p' build.sh && find freetype2 -maxdepth 3 -type f -path '*fuzz*' -o -path '*tests*' | grep -E 'fuzz|ftfuzzer' | head -200"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
./autogen.sh
./configure
make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) all
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11   -I./include -I.   ./src/tools/ftfuzzer/ftfuzzer.cc -o $OUT/ftfuzzer   ./objs/*.o -lFuzzingEngine   /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libarchive.a   ./objs/.libs/libfreetype.a
zip -j $OUT/ftfuzzer_seed_corpus.zip $SRC/font-corpus/*
cp $SRC/*.options $OUT/

extras.command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,220p' build.sh && find freetype2 -maxdepth 3 -type f -path '*fuzz*' -o -path '*tests*' | grep -E 'fuzz|ftfuzzer' | head -200
